Allah swears by the night when it covers.
And by the day when it shines.
And by the One who created male and female.
Your efforts are different from each other.
As for the one who gives and is mindful of Allah.
And believes in the best reward.
We will make the way easy for him toward ease.
But as for the one who is stingy and thinks he does not need Allah.
And denies the best reward.
We will make the way easy for him toward hardship.
His wealth will not help him when he falls.
Showing the way is up to Us.
And this life and the next life both belong to Us.
So I have warned you of a blazing Fire.
Only the most unhappy person will burn in it.
The one who rejected and turned away.
But the most mindful of Allah will be kept away from it.
The one who gives his wealth to purify himself.
Not to pay anyone back for a favor.
But only to please his Lord, the Most High.
And soon he will be pleased.
